remarks: Luxury condo living in Stamford! Gorgeous open concept 2BR/ 2BA unit features a beautiful modern kitchen with granite countertops, stainless appliances, and a large kitchen island that doubles as a breakfast bar. Light floods into the large living/ dining area through oversize windows and a door leading to the large terrace. 9' ceilings, hardwood floors and and electric fireplace add to the luxurious feel. The primary bedroom suite has brand new carpet, a large walk-in closet, and a full ensuite bath. The second bedroom has hardwood floors, a large closet, and doors that open onto the large terrace. There is a full size laundry in unit, with extra storage in closet. Apartment has been fully painted. Building amenities include a fitness center, a professionally landscaped courtyard with community gas grills and seating, covered garage parking with one assigned space and plentiful guest/ visitor parking, meeting room, concierge, two elevator access points. Very conveniently located near the Stamford Metro North/Amtrak Station, I-95 on/off ramps, all of the fun in downtown Stamford proper, etc. It's a great place to live!
